resources.string: Speak into the remote\'s mic as usual: music and video searches open in SmartTube instead of the official YouTube, and channel requests open in VTVgo / TV360. Reads what the Google Assistant just heard through the TV\'s own ADB and only knows which app just appeared; it doesn\'t read the screen or catch remote keys.
Map Voice: the TV is asking \"Allow debugging?\". Choose Always allow, then OK, so Map Voice can hear what you say.
